sections.heading: The setup
sections.body: The S&P 500 sits near the top of its one-month range at 7,747.71, about 0.7% off the high. The Nasdaq 100 is mid-range at 29,482.32, roughly 2% below its recent peak. The VIX is quiet, parked near the bottom of its own one-month band at 14.32. The Euro Stoxx 50 is the outlier, trading closer to its one-month low. Against that calm backdrop, six large-cap operating names in our tracked universe report this week, concentrated in technology (four names) with one each in healthcare and consumer-defensive.

sections.heading: What to watch
sections.body: Mon: PANW US opens the week reporting into the technology cohort, where the median 3-day reaction across 503 names has run a modest +0.41%. Tue: DELL US follows in the same technology group. Wed: SAIL US reports alongside COO US, which sits in healthcare — a 452-ticker group holding a flat +0.12% median reaction. Thu closes with ADBE US, the week's largest technology report, and KR US in consumer-defensive, the only sector among this week's reporters showing a negative median reaction.

sections.heading: Signals to trust
sections.body: Mining leads the mechanical sector table at +6.62% median 3-day reaction across 160 tickers, though this week's reporters don't touch it. Oil-gas sits at the other pole, -2.21% median across 33 tickers on a thick 1,020-item news window. Consumer-defensive, home to KR US this week, is milder at -0.70% median across 320 tickers.
